CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT:
I.
PROCLAMATIONS/PRESENTATIONS:
a.
Proclaim Thursday, May 4, 2017, as a day set apart for the Annual Mayor's Prayer Breakfast in recognition of the National Day of Prayer.
Ia CC Proc Mayors Prayer breakfast 17
b.
Proclaim the week of April 9 - 15, 2017, as "National Public Safety Telecommunications Week" in the City of La Habra.
Ib PD Proc Telecommunications 2017
c.
Proclaim the week of April 9 - 15, 2017, as "Animal Control Officer Appreciation Week" in the City of La Habra.
Ic PD Proc AnimalControlOfficerAppre 17
d.
Proclaim April 2017 as the "DMV/Donate Life California Month" in the City of La Habra.
Id CC Prof DMV DonateLife17
e.
Recognition of Allan Nisle for his outstanding service and 20 years of volunteerism as a member of the La Habra Police Radio Patrol Unit.
Ie PD Proc Volunteer Allan Nisle
f.
Proclaim April 2017 as "Fair Housing Month" in the City of La Habra.
If CD Proc Fair Housing Month 17
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
PROPOSED ITEMS:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
Approve temporary signage for Citrus Fair at the northeast corner of La Habra Boulevard and Euclid Street and at the northwest corner of La Habra Boulevard and Harbor Boulevard subject to the satisfaction of the Director of Community and Economic Development.
III2 CD Citrus Fair Signage
3.
Approve and adopt a resolution prohibiting stopping, standing, and parking at all times on north side of Whittier Boulevard east of the Cervetto Homes driveway (Ellie Street), as follows:
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON EAST WHITTIER BOULEVARD EASTERLY OF THE CERVETTO HOMES DRIVEWAY (ELLIE STREET).
III3 PW WhittierCervettoDrwy
4.
Approve Notice of Completion for the Neighborhood B, D & O Traffic Management Plans, Project No. 2-TC-15.
III4 PW NOC NTMPBDO2-TC-15
5.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00110689 through 00110864 totaling $1,709,557.67; and WIRE TRANSFER: Approve Wire Date 3/30/17 for a total of $48,293.45.
III5 FAS Warrants 20170403

V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
1.
Duly noticed public hearing to consider amending Chapter 9.22 of Title 9 of the City of La Habra Municipal Code Relating to Firework Use, Discharge, Possession, Storage and Sale on Private Property.
a.
APPROVE FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. ______ ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA AMENDING CHAPTER 9.22 OF TITLE 9 OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO FIREWORK USE, DISCHARGE, POSSESSION, STORAGE AND SALE ON PRIVATE PROPERTY.
V1 PD Fireworks ord
VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS:
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
1.
Consider appointments for annual expiring terms and vacancies on the Community Services Commission, Planning Commission, and Beautification Committee.
a.
Appoint one individual to the Planning Commission to fill one 4-year term expiring on March 31, 2021.
b.
Appoint one individual to the Community Services Commission to fill one 3-year term expiring March 31, 2020.
c.
Appoint two individuals to the Community Services Commission to fill two 1-year terms expiring March 31, 2018.
d.
Appoint one individual to the Beautification Committee to fill one seat with an indefinite term.
e.
Ratify La Habra Chamber of Commerce appointment of Graciela (Grace) Garcia to the Beautification Committee to fill one vacancy with an indefinite term.
